summary: Periodic ESA firm-mapping estimates cover 2015, 2016, 2019, 2023 and 2025. Core development/publishing can be derived from explicit subsectors for 2019/2023/2025. Broad totals are not a consistent time series; no verified national contractor or foreign-national share was found.

search_log.outcome: BLS software publishing includes non-game software; rejected as game-only employment.

search_log.outcome: English source methods distinguish domestic remote workers and service firms but do not establish individual freelancer or nationality census.

series.label: Core developer and publisher company employment
series.worker_status: Company workforce; precise employment-status scope varies
series.contractor_treatment: Individuals with contractor status not separately enumerated; specialist service firms excluded from this derived subset.
series.method: Sum of Developer + Developer/Publisher + Publisher categories in ESA firm database.
series.comparison_note: Definition close across three editions, but database methodology changed. Plot discrete observations or explicit methodology breaks; no 2019 index.

series.label: Broad direct games-industry employment
series.industry_scope: Software, hardware, retail, services/support; 2019 also includes arcades and broad-retail allocations
series.worker_status: Company workforce; precise employment-status scope varies
series.comparison_note: 2019-to-2023 removes entire activities and changes firm estimation; 2025 improves small-firm and remote coverage. Broad series cannot measure like-for-like job loss.

series.label: Software-sector employment
series.industry_scope: Developer, developer/publisher, publisher, tools, platform/other software activities
series.worker_status: Company workforce; precise employment-status scope varies
series.comparison_note: 2025 adds Platform explicitly; 2023 other may include some activities. Method changes preclude index.

series.label: Specialist game-development services employment
series.industry_scope: Creative development support, localisation, porting, related services
series.worker_status: Company workforce; precise employment-status scope varies
series.contractor_treatment: Includes staff of contracted service firms; not a total freelancer headcount.
series.comparison_note: Different support-service coverage by edition; do not add this to contractor headcounts from other sources.

series.label: Earlier ESA mapping-project reported employment
series.industry_scope: Developers and publishers; publisher category also includes hardware/software manufacturers, service providers and distributors
series.worker_status: Company workforce; precise employment-status scope varies
series.sample_size: 2015: 1,522 locations with employment and founding-year information; 2016: 1,682 locations reporting employment
series.comparison_note: 2015 table excludes 151 locations without founding-year data; 2016 covers wider reporting universe. No comparable link to newer TEConomy series.

limitations: No complete annual national series: unpublished years remain blank.
2015/2016 mapping totals and 2019 broad total cannot be joined as the same scope.
US geography follows domestic employees, including US workers of foreign firms; not US citizenship.
